case.pattern_description: Unauthorized online transaction reported by the cardholder. Step-up authentication confirmed the customer did not authorize the charge, suggesting compromised card details used in a Card Not Present (CNP) environment.

evidence.claim: Transaction 3558054 is an online credit purchase with a risk score of 0.38.

case.summary: Customer C13171 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $55.68 on card C13171-K2. Although the initial risk score was 0.38, step-up authentication confirmed the customer did not initiate the purchase. The case is closed as fraud, and the card has been flagged for replacement.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer confirmed they did not make the purchase at the specified merchant and still have the physical card in their possession.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Step-up authentication moved the fraud probability from 0.38 to 0.85, confirming the customer's report.

sar.reason: Confirmed unauthorized transaction reported by customer.
sar.narrative: On December 19, 2016, a suspicious online transaction (ID: 3558054) totaling $55.68 was processed using card C13171-K2 belonging to customer C13171. The customer proactively contacted the bank to report that they did not authorize this specific purchase. The transaction was conducted via an online channel using a Hotmail email address. A Tier 2 investigation was initiated, and step-up authentication was performed to validate the customer's claim. The customer confirmed they were not responsible for the transaction and were in possession of the physical card at the time of the event. Based on this validation, the transaction is determined to be fraudulent. The card has been blocked to prevent further unauthorized use. This activity is consistent with Card Not Present fraud involving compromised card information.
